R5B-deer-atv-0005.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R5B-deer-atv-0005.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Sheemahant Mainline FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-5-005 unit 15-110 (official), 280 m SW. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2006 (20 years old), 850 m E.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHvm4): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
S facing slope, 13 degrees: sun melts snow first.

MU 5-7 is not listed in the Region 5 white tailed deer rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 100 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.75736, -126.59393, where the truck road ends (Sheemahant Mainline FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 4.6 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 90 m NE, climb about 25 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2006 cutblock (850 m E) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-7, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R5B-deer-atv-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-7: about 55 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.01 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 25 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
